simple.meaning: צָנַם (tsânam) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to blast or shrink.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Genesis, beginning at Genesis 41:23. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָנַם (H6798) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: צָנַם (tsânam) / H6798 is traced through Genesis 41:23 with source-language evidence and verse context.
